uutiset.s: Scott Parker's stuttering start as West Ham manager continued in his first match at the London Stadium as bottom club Preston battled their way to a 1-1 draw.

uutiset.s: Sheffield United got back to winning ways as they breezed past struggling Watford with a 4-0 victory at Bramall Lane.

uutiset.s: Middlesbrough scored a goal either side of half-time to climb top of the Sky Bet Championship with a 2-0 win that piled further pressure on Bristol City boss Michael Skubala.

uutiset.t: Bournemouth make more history with comfortable win against Forest
uutiset.s: Bournemouth continued their unstoppable form with a comfortable 2-0 victory against Nottingham Forest and created two bits of history in the process.

uutiset.t: Falkirk beat St Johnstone to extend winning run to six
uutiset.s: Falkirk clung on to clock up six top-flight wins in a row for the first time since 1966 with a 2-1 home victory over St Johnstone.

uutiset.s: Celtic looked refreshed after the international break as they eased to a 4-1 win against St Mirren.
